  Exam Date & Time: 11-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Internet of things security [IT-5022]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Examine the several stages of the real-world evolution of the Internet of things. Describe  
  its uses in a variety of applications as well.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify step-by-step procedures for designing IoT application in Hospital Domain with  
  suitable diagram.                                                                      (3)  
  
  C)      What Are the Various Home Automation Technology Operating Standards?                         (2)  
  2)           Identify the smart home network using pervasive connectivity.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      List out the function of embedded systems and communication protocols on the Internet  
  of Things.                                                                            (3)  
  
  C)      What kind of technology evaluates all the data that Internet of Things devices send  
  back? Describe everything in detail.                                                         (2)  
  
  3)           Describe how IoT security standards in air pollution and noise pollution monitoring may  
  help safeguard the environment better.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Install the Smart Irrigation System by using the multi-server authentication approach.       (3)  
  C)      List the privacy risks that IoT devices most frequently face.                                (2)  
  4)           Determine the secure connections, management, and analysis of IoT data in wearable  
  gadgets.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Examine the smart parking use case using IoE.                                                (3)  
  C)      What is the most recent drones version available in current market?                          (2)
